title: Trump and Xi hold US-China talks in Oval Office
summary: The presidents of the world's two largest economies are in Washington for what Donald Trump has billed a "big day." Bilateral trade, AI and geopolitics are all on the menu. Follow DW for the latest.

image.caption: Thursday's talks are set to culminate in a state banquetImage: Saul Loeb/AFP

blocks.text: Melania Trump, Madame Peng head to Asian art museum

blocks.caption: Peng Liyuan and Melania Trump wanted to highlight bilateral cultural ties with their trip to the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian ArtImage: Finn Gomez/AP Photo/Getty Images/picture alliance

blocks.text: First Lady Melania Trump and Xi's wife Peng Liyuan left their husbands behind to tour one of the largest Asian art museums in the US.
The visit to the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art in Washington was supposed to celebrate cultural ties between the US and China.
Both wives are known for their focus on soft power and cultural issues, one is a former fashion model and the other a soprano.

blocks.caption: A singer herself, Madame Peng has taken on a more public role than her predecessorsImage: Finn Gomez/AP Photo/Getty Images/picture alliance

blocks.text: A choir of young school children from the Hope Chinese School sang to the duo as they toured the building, singing famous Chinese folk songs including "Song and Smile" and "Jasmine Flower."

It's the first public meeting between the two spouses in nearly a decade, since a 2017 encounter in Beijing. A crowd had gathered on the sidewalk across from the museum, some waving Chinese and American flags.

blocks.caption: Melania Trump had said in an interview earlier on Thursday that she wanted to show Peng Liyuan the 'connection with the culture, with us and China'Image: Finn Gomez/AP Photo/Getty Images/picture alliance
